sources.title: Frontiers | Low-cost fine-tuning of SmolVLA with smoothness ...
sources.snippet: Because the auxiliary classifier is used only during training and the runtime chunk length remains fixed at k = 8, we denote the configuration SmolVLA+LoRA+S&C (smoothness and chunk-aware auxiliary losses) rather than "adaptive." We evaluate four LIBERO suites with a unified protocol of 500 episodes per cell (50 episodes × 10 task variants).
